stem:
The stem and leaf plot shows the ages of riders on a roller coaster.

          Ages of Roller
          Coaster Riders
    Stem | Leaf
    1    | 0 3 4 4 8 9
    2    | 1 1 1 4 7
    3    | 4 5 8
    4    | 2 6 9
    5    | 0 2 3 7
    6    | 2
    7    | 0 4

3|5 means 35 years.

Based on the stem and leaf plot, which statement is true?

options.label: A
options.text: There were more riders between 10 and 38 years of age than there were between 42 and 74 years of age.

options.label: B
options.text: There were more riders 14 years of age than riders of any other single age.

options.label: C
options.text: There were 31 riders on the roller coaster.

options.label: D
options.text: There were exactly 3 riders over the age of 50 years.
